question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a orange ball, Claire has a blue ball, Dave has a purple ball, Eve has a black ball, Fred has a gold ball, and Gertrude has a grey ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Alice and Fred swap balls. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) orange ball
(C) blue ball
(D) purple ball
(E) black ball
(F) gold ball
(G) grey ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (white, orange, blue, purple, black, gold, grey)
1. Alice and Gertrude swap: (grey, orange, blue, purple, black, gold, white)
2. Alice and Fred swap: (gold, orange, blue, purple, black, grey, white)
3. Dave and Gertrude swap: (gold, orange, blue, white, black, grey, purple)
4. Gertrude and Fred swap: (gold, orange, blue, white, black, purple, grey)
5. Gertrude and Dave swap: (gold, orange, blue, grey, black, purple, white)
6. Dave and Alice swap: (grey, orange, blue, gold, black, purple, white)
7. Gertrude and Dave swap: (grey, orange, blue, white, black, purple, gold)
Claire has the blue ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
